tooltips.generatedTitle: This title is AI-generated and based solely on the description in the feedback form. It may contain inaccuracies or omissions.
tooltips.autoSensitive: The AI has automatically categorized this as sensitive based on earlier given definitions of sensitive.
tooltips.suggestedFollowUpActions: Suggested follow up actions are generated based on historic data, SOPs and best practises.
tooltips.dateTimePaperRecorded: Date and time when the feedback was first recorded on a paper form by a staff member or volunteer (if applicable).
tooltips.dateTimeKoboStarted: Date and time when the feedback form was first opened or started in KoBoToolbox.
tooltips.dateTimePaperRecordedRaw: Date and time when the feedback was first recorded on a paper form by a staff member or volunteer (if applicable). Raw string input waiting to be transformed into datetime format.
tooltips.dateTimeKoboStartedRaw: Date and time when the feedback form was first opened or started in KoBoToolbox. Raw string input waiting to be transformed into datetime format.
tooltips.dateTimeKoboCompleted: Date and time when the feedback was fully completed in KoBoToolbox by the enumerator or staff member.
tooltips.dateTimeKoboCompletedRaw: Date and time when the feedback was fully completed in KoBoToolbox by the enumerator or staff member. Raw string input waiting to be transformed into date timeformat.
tooltips.dateTimeKoboSubmitted: Date and time when the completed KoBo form was submitted and sent from KoBoToolbox to EspoCRM
tooltips.dateTimeKoboSubmittedRaw: Date and time when the completed KoBo form was submitted and sent from KoBoToolbox. Raw string input waiting to be transformed into datetime format.
tooltips.dateTimeFollowUpNeeded: Date and time when the feedback was marked as requiring follow‑up action in EspoCRM.
tooltips.dateTimeAssigned: Date and time when responsibility for this feedback was assigned to a user in EspoCRM.
tooltips.dateTimeClosed: Date and time when the feedback handling process was completed and the status was set to closed.
tooltips.durationKoboCompletion: Time taken to complete the KoBo form, calculated as the difference between “KoBo form started” and “KoBo form completed” in minutes.
tooltips.durationPaperToDigital: Time between the feedback being recorded on paper and being registered digitally in EspoCRM in hours.
tooltips.durationToAssignment: Time between the feedback record being received in EspoCRM and assignment to a responsible user. In hours.
tooltips.durationToFollowUp:
Time it took from creating the feedback record until it was first identified that follow‑up was needed.
This duration is historical and does not change if follow‑up is later cancelled or resolved. In hours.
tooltips.durationToClosure: Total time between feedback collection and final closure, reflecting responsiveness from a community member perspective. In hours.
tooltips.durationKoboToDigital: Time between the feedback start being recorded in Kobo and being registered digitally in EspoCRM in hours.
tooltips.dateTimeEventOccurred: Date and time when the event occurred that this feedback refers to, as reported by the community member. This may differ from when the feedback was collected or entered into the system.
tooltips.dateTimeEventOccurredRaw: Date and time when the event occurred that this feedback refers to, as reported by the community member. This may differ from when the feedback was collected or entered into the system. Raw string input waiting to be transformed into date timeformat.
tooltips.durationEventToReporting: Time between the event occurring and the first moment feedback was reported to the Red Cross/Crescent, regardless of channel. (earliest of {dateTimePaperRecorded, dateTimeKoboStarted} − dateTimeEventOccurred). In hours.
tooltips.durationCommunityToAssignment:
Total time between the event occurring and the feedback being assigned to a responsible user at the Red Cross.  Typically calculated as:
KoBo path: (durationEventToReporting + durationKoboToDigital + durationToAssignment)
Paper path: (durationEventToReporting + durationPaperToDigital + durationToAssignment)
tooltips.durationCommunityToClosureDecomposed:
Total time between the event occurring and feedback being closed, calculated as the sum of all individual phases in the feedback journey.  Typically calculated as:
KoBo path: (durationEventToReporting + durationKoboToDigital + durationToAssignment + durationAssignmentToClosure)
Paper path: (durationEventToReporting + durationPaperToDigital + durationToAssignment + durationAssignmentToClosure)  This should approximately reconcile with Closure Time.
tooltips.durationReportingDelayShare: Proportion of the total feedback lifecycle that elapsed before the community reported the feedback. (durationEventToReporting ÷ durationToClosure). From 0 to 1.
tooltips.durationDigitalToClosure:
Time between the feedback record being created in EspoCRM and the feedback being closed.
This measures internal handling and resolution time after the feedback entered the system, excluding any delay before digital registration.
tooltips.usernameKoboToolbox: Username recorded on the device or web form at the time of data collection. This value is user‑provided and may differ from the authenticated Kobo account.
tooltips.deviceIDKoboToolbox: Device ID from the browser/app of the enumerator from KoboToolbox.
tooltips.phonenumberKoboToolbox: This phone number is automatically taken from the enumerator’s KoboToolbox app account if they are logged in and have set a phone number.
tooltips.koboToolboxFormID: Numeric submission identifier assigned by KoboToolbox. Unique within the project and primarily used internally by Kobo.
tooltips.koboToolboxUUID: Globally unique identifier (UUID) for the submission, generated by KoboToolbox; may change if the submission is edited.
tooltips.statusKobo: Validation status of the submission in KoboToolbox (e.g. submitted, validated). Used in Kobo’s data review workflow.
tooltips.koboToolboxFormVersion: Identifier of the XLSForm version that was used to create this submission. Changes when the form structure is updated and redeployed.
tooltips.submittedByNameKobo: KoboToolbox account username that submitted the record. System‑generated and authoritative when authentication is used.
tooltips.autoSummaryEnabled: If enabled, a summary is generated automatically by the system.
tooltips.autoCodingEnabled: If enabled, the system automatically applies types, categories and/or codes.
tooltips.autoSensitiveEnabled: If enabled, the system automatically checks if this is likely to be sensitive feedback and gives output in the 'Auto Flagged Sensitive (AI)' and the 'Explanation automatically flagged sensitive (AI)' field.
tooltips.autoCodingStatus: Controls and displays the status of automatic coding. Set this field to 'Requested' to start AI-assisted coding. The status will be updated automatically as processing progresses.
tooltips.autoSummaryStatus: Controls and displays the status of automatic summarization. Set this field to 'Requested' to generate an AI summary. The status will be updated automatically as processing progresses.
tooltips.autoSensitiveStatus: Controls and displays the status of AI-based sensitive content detection. Set this field to 'Requested' to start the analysis. The status will be updated automatically as processing progresses.
